import os, subprocess
from pathlib import Path

wt=Path("/Users/steventran/.do_again/selfdev-20261007")
expected="6f219b829fac59a7ca0e0b27cdff81b9d04c365b"

def run(args, check=True, env=None):
    return subprocess.run(args,cwd=wt,text=True,capture_output=True,check=check,env=env)

head=run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.strip()
branch=run(["git","branch","--show-current"]).stdout.strip()
if head!=expected or branch!="feat/self-dogfood-20261007":
    raise SystemExit(f"unexpected state head={head} branch={branch}")

p=wt/"tests/test_request_fingerprints.py"
text=p.read_text()

if "import json\n" not in text:
    text=text.replace("import itertools\n","import itertools\nimport json\n",1)

old='''    def test_preclaim_cancellation_publishes_cancelled_receipt_without_execution(self):
        request_id = "cancel-before-execution"
        request = self.request(request_id)
        request_path = self.agent.requests_dir / f"{request_id}.json"
        request_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        request_path.write_text(json.dumps(request), encoding="utf-8")
        cancellation = {
            "schema_version": 1,
            "request_id": request_id,
            "request_fingerprint": request_fingerprint(request),
            "state": "cancelled_before_execution",
            "reason": "test cancellation",
            "cancelled_at_utc": request["issued_at_utc"],
        }
        cancel_path = self.agent.cancellations_dir / f"{request_id}.json"
        cancel_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        cancel_path.write_text(json.dumps(cancellation), encoding="utf-8")
        with patch.object(self.agent, "acquire_remote_claim") as claim, patch.object(
            self.agent.executor, "execute"
        ) as execute, patch.object(self.agent, "publish_receipt"), patch.object(
            self.agent, "notify_receipt"
        ):
            changed = self.agent.process_request(request_path)
        self.assertTrue(changed)
        claim.assert_not_called()
        execute.assert_not_called()
        ledger = self.agent.local_ledger(request_id)
        self.assertEqual(ledger["receipt"]["state"], "cancelled")
'''
new='''    def test_preclaim_cancellation_publishes_cancelled_receipt_without_execution(self):
        request_id = "cancel-before-execution"
        request = self.request(request_id)
        agent = self.agent()
        request_path = agent.requests_dir / f"{request_id}.json"
        request_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        request_path.write_text(json.dumps(request), encoding="utf-8")
        cancellation = {
            "schema_version": 1,
            "request_id": request_id,
            "request_fingerprint": request_fingerprint(request),
            "state": "cancelled_before_execution",
            "reason": "test cancellation",
            "cancelled_at_utc": request["issued_at_utc"],
        }
        cancel_path = agent.cancellations_dir / f"{request_id}.json"
        cancel_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        cancel_path.write_text(json.dumps(cancellation), encoding="utf-8")
        with patch.object(agent, "acquire_remote_claim") as claim, patch.object(
            agent.executor, "execute"
        ) as execute, patch.object(agent, "publish_receipt"), patch.object(
            agent, "notify_receipt"
        ):
            changed = agent.process_request(request_path)
        self.assertTrue(changed)
        claim.assert_not_called()
        execute.assert_not_called()
        ledger = agent.local_ledger(request_id)
        self.assertEqual(ledger["receipt"]["state"], "cancelled")
'''
if old not in text:
    raise SystemExit("expected cancellation test body missing")
text=text.replace(old,new,1)
p.write_text(text)

env=os.environ.copy()
env["PYTHONPATH"]=str(wt/"src")
run(["python3","-m","py_compile","src/do_again/core/agent.py","src/do_again/cli.py","tests/test_cli.py","tests/test_request_fingerprints.py"],env=env)
print("py_compile=ok")

focused=run(
    ["python3","-m","unittest","tests.test_cli","tests.test_request_fingerprints","tests.test_agent_claims"],
    check=False,env=env
)
print("=== focused stdout ===")
print(focused.stdout)
print("=== focused stderr ===")
print(focused.stderr)
print("focused_rc="+str(focused.returncode))
if focused.returncode!=0:
    raise SystemExit(focused.returncode)

run(["git","add","src/do_again/core/agent.py","src/do_again/cli.py","tests/test_cli.py","tests/test_request_fingerprints.py"])
commit=run(["git","commit","-m","Add safe request cancel and retry controls"],check=False)
print("=== commit stdout ===")
print(commit.stdout)
print("=== commit stderr ===")
print(commit.stderr)
if commit.returncode!=0:
    raise SystemExit(commit.returncode)

print("new_head="+run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.strip())
print("status_after="+repr(run(["git","status","--porcelain=v1"]).stdout))
